Subject: Run Away With Me
Message: Dina. Maybe this is stupid but let's runaway. I made so many mistakes and yet all I can think about is losing you. I thought I could delete all our emails but I couldn't... not all of them. I thought I could forget you but you're the most important person in my life. I talked to Dan about taking Bunny for awhile... he's always been good with her. I'm not sure what to tell my family or if I'll tell them but this is what I want. If it's what you want too meet me at our spot after work. I hope to see you there.
